summary: Paylocity Holding Corporation filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing entry into an amended and restated revolving credit agreement replacing its July 2019 facility. The new $1.75 billion senior secured revolving facility, agented by PNC Bank, matures September 17, 2031, with $81.25 million outstanding at closing, $175 million each in swing-loan and letter-of-credit sublimits, and an $875 million accordion. Interest is Term SOFR or base rate plus leverage-based margins; no board recommendation, premium, or deal terms apply, as this is a routine refinancing.
